# A component built at run time -- state of its own under a `for` -- whose
# click writes a page var that a reactive `if` of the page reads. Every body's
# updates were injected as it was walked, components before the package body,
# so the handler's re-fire of the page's slot was dropped for want of the
# slot's function: the click wrote the var and the sign never showed on fyne,
# gtk4 and html. In a test build the root component is the page, whose slot
# the writer took for another component's, and gtk4 kept the page's box a
# local of its build, which the handler then had no name for.
#
# cache.sngl writes from a query's answer in such a copy instead, a cache the
# page's sign reads. html renders the page's slot at its anchor, and the
# factory's re-fire handed it the node the page named, a name the factory's
# own node also bore: the page raised that the node to remove was not a
# child. Android wrote the map in a field of the state struct in place,
# `names.failures = names.failures + (…)`, and never recomposed. Its fetch
# waits on the script harness's server.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none cache.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go cache.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go cache.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go cache.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html cache.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin cache.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var failures = 0
var round = 0

// A component with state of its own, so a copy under a `for` is built at
// run time, writing a package var from its click.
component writer(key string) ui.node {
    var clicks = 0

    ui.button #w(text=key, @click {
        clicks += 1
        failures += 1
    })
}

component sign(@retry()) ui.node {
    ui.button #b(text="again", @click { retry() })
}

component errs ui.node {
    if failures > 0 {
        sign #s(@retry { round += 1 })
    }
}

component page ui.node {
    var keys = ["a", "b"]

    ui.vbox {
        for var k = keys {
            writer #writer(key=k)
        }
        errs #errs()
    }
}

func testAWriteInABuiltInstanceShowsTheSign(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.writer[0].w.click()
    t.assert(failures == 1)
    var s = c.errs.s
    t.assert(s != null)
    if s != null {
        s.b.click()
    }
    t.assert(round == 1)
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
-- cache.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Failed {
    why   string
    round int
}

struct Cache[V any] {
    answers  map[string, V]
    failures map[string, Failed]
    round    int
}

func Cache[V].known(this Cache[V], key string) => this.answers.contains(key)

func Cache[V].failedNow(this Cache[V], key string) => this.failures.get(key, Failed{why="", round=-1}).round == this.round

func Cache[V].wanted(this Cache[V], key string) => !this.known(key) && !this.failedNow(key)

func Cache[V].failing(this Cache[V]) => this.failures.values().filter(func(f Failed) => f.round == this.round)

func Cache[V].retry(this ref[Cache[V]]) {
    this.round += 1
}

component cached[T any, V any, F any](key string, fetch func(async.Lifetime) async.Result[T], keep func(T) V, :cache Cache[V]) F {
    if cache.wanted(key) {
        async.query(
            on = key,
            fetch = func(k string, life async.Lifetime) => fetch(life),
            @load(got) { cache.answers[key] = keep(got) },
            @fail(f) { cache.failures[key] = Failed{why=f.message, round=cache.round} },
        )
    }
}

// Fails "bad" with a 500, and answers anything else with its length.
func lookupCall(key string, life async.Lifetime) async.Result[int] {
    match var r = http.get(url="http://127.0.0.1:47819/status/{key == "bad" ? 500 : 200}", life=life) {
        failed { return {failed=r} }
        ok {
            if r.status != 200 {
                return {failed={kind=async.FailureKind.server, message="no", code="{r.status}"}}
            }
            return {ok=key.length()}
        }
    }
}

var names = Cache[int]{answers={}, failures={}, round=0}

component lookup(kind string, slug string) ui.node {
    var key = "{kind}/{slug}"

    cached(key=key, fetch=func(life async.Lifetime) => lookupCall(slug, life), keep=func(got int) => got, :cache=names)
}

component sign(@retry()) ui.node {
    ui.button #b(text="again", @click { retry() })
}

component errs ui.node {
    if names.failing().length() > 0 {
        sign #s(@retry { names.retry() })
    }
}

component page ui.node {
    var keys = ["one", "bad"]

    ui.vbox {
        for var k = keys {
            lookup(kind=`word`, slug=k)
        }
        errs #errs()
    }
}

func testAFailureShowsTheSign(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.wait(func() => names.failing().length() == 1, 5000)
    var s = c.errs.s
    t.assert(s != null)
    if s != null {
        s.b.click()
    }
    t.assert(names.round == 1)
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
